protocol.evaluation: Expanding rolling origin. Common origins and complete 12-step paths for all candidates. byHorizon aggregates steps 1..H; atHorizon reports step H only.
protocol.maseDenominator: Mean absolute seasonal-naive training difference |y[t]-y[t-12]|, recomputed at each origin.
protocol.intervals: Horizon-specific empirical 2.5/10/90/97.5% quantiles of validation actual-minus-predicted errors, frozen before test. Lower bound clipped at zero; share bounds clipped to [0,1]. No Gaussian or guaranteed coverage claim.
protocol.testFreshness: Historical dates already inspected in prior experiments; all outputs remain experimental even if retrospective gates pass.
protocol.originDependence: Overlapping targets mean prediction errors and coverage observations are dependent; no nominal significance from their raw count.
protocol.macroAvailability: Monthly financing and credit observed only through origin-2 index; origin is first forecast month. Unknown subsequent levels held flat. Never uses realized future macro values.
protocol.vintage: Current source vintage; assumed one-month publication delay. Historical releases and revisions unavailable, so this is pseudo-out-of-sample, not true real-time validation.

regional.warning: Conditional association, not causal demand or actionable sales potential. GDP per capita is not household income. Counts refer to Jan–Sep registrations, not unique residents; fleets/headquarters and spatial dependence matter. GDP 2023, population 2026, income/density/urbanisation 2022 and PAM vintage differ. Overdispersion is reported; HC1 does not repair missing controls or spatial dependence.
regional.zeroPolicy: Observed zero MIT counts are retained in Poisson with log(population) offset. Municipalities absent from the registration table are excluded and are never silently treated as zero.
regional.validation: In-sample conditional fit, no out-of-sample regional predictive validation. Expected-minus-observed is not unmet demand.

registrations.selection: Lowest validation MAE across the complete 12-month path. Test scores do not select the model. Published counts then undergo national nonnegative weighted least-squares reconciliation.

coherence.method: Nonnegative weighted least squares on national market = MIT + nonMIT; share = MIT / market.
coherence.weightMethod: Inverse seasonal-naive training error second moments, recomputed at each origin; diagonal weights, not an estimated full residual covariance or MinT.
coherence.warning: Marginal intervals are calibrated separately and are not simultaneous joint bands. UF hierarchy is a separate experiment; its reconciled paths must not be represented as reconciliation of these SARIMAX paths.

protocol.evaluation: Expanding rolling origin. Common origins and complete 12-step paths for all candidates. byHorizon aggregates steps 1..H; atHorizon reports step H only.
protocol.maseDenominator: Mean absolute seasonal-naive training difference |y[t]-y[t-12]|, recomputed at each origin.
protocol.intervals: Horizon-specific empirical 2.5/10/90/97.5% quantiles of validation actual-minus-predicted errors, frozen before test. Lower bound clipped at zero; share bounds clipped to [0,1]. No Gaussian or guaranteed coverage claim.
protocol.testFreshness: Historical dates already inspected in prior experiments; all outputs remain experimental even if retrospective gates pass.
protocol.originDependence: Overlapping targets mean prediction errors and coverage observations are dependent; no nominal significance from their raw count.
protocol.macroAvailability: Monthly financing and credit observed only through origin-2 index; origin is first forecast month. Unknown subsequent levels held flat. Never uses realized future macro values.
protocol.vintage: Current source vintage; assumed one-month publication delay. Historical releases and revisions unavailable, so this is pseudo-out-of-sample, not true real-time validation.

simulation.reason: No causal model, identification strategy or validated intervention response. Phase 4 is outside this task.

limitations: All tests are retrospective on a current vintage; historical release vintages unavailable.
The evaluation dates were inspected in prior experiments; no fresh independent validation claim.
Forecast intervals are empirical and approximate; overlap, regime changes and model selection affect coverage.
Credit concessions are nominal flows, not outstanding balances or real credit. Monthly macro availability is conservatively assumed, not verified historical release-by-release.
Regional controls use different vintages and omit unavailable variables; GDP per capita must never be renamed household income.
This package reconciles the national count hierarchy only. A separate UF experiment does not reconcile these model paths; no joint probabilistic coherence is claimed.
PNAD rolling-quarter values are not treated as independent monthly observations or inserted into this fixed model.
